name: Side Crunch (Cable)
instructions: Attach a rope to a high pulley and kneel sideways, holding the rope near your head.
Crunch sideways, bringing your ribs toward your hip.
longevityNotes: A strong, stable core protects the spine in every other movement and makes daily tasks — bending, twisting, reaching — safer. Core endurance matters more than core power.
overview: A cable side crunch that trains the obliques with resistance.
